meta.name: browser-automation
meta.description: Use when the user asks to automate browser tasks, scrape websites, fill forms, capture screenshots, extract structured data from web pages, or build web automation workflows. NOT for testing — use playwright-pro for that.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动执行浏览器操作，如填表、截图和提取数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用脚本控制浏览器完成重复性网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to script browser actions for repetitive web tasks

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能按你的要求用 Playwright 自动操作浏览器:抓取网页数据、填写表单、截图/存 PDF、保存登录状态,并生成可复用脚本。
howto.when: 当你说要自动化浏览器任务、抓取网站、填写表单、截图等,或要求从网页提取结构化数据时触发;不用于测试。

say.text: 帮我把这个商品列表页的标题和价格抓下来,存成 CSV
say.note: 会生成抓取脚本并运行提取数据。

say.text: 写一个自动登录门户并下载报表的脚本
say.note: 会保存登录状态,再走表单流程下载。

say.text: 对这个页面做整页截图,并导出成 PDF
say.note: 会生成截图和 PDF 转换脚本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate browser operations with Playwright on request: scrape web data, fill forms, take screenshots/PDFs, save sessions, and generate reusable scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to automate browser tasks, scrape websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract structured data from pages, or build browser automation workflows. Not for testing (use playwright-pro).

say_en.text: Scrape the titles and prices from this product listing page into a CSV
say_en.note: It generates a scraping script and runs the extraction.

say_en.text: Write a script that logs into the portal and downloads the report
say_en.note: It saves the session state, then goes through the form flow.

say_en.text: Take a full-page screenshot of this page and export it as a PDF
say_en.note: It generates screenshot and PDF conversion scripts.
